summary: Adapter requires backend hidden_state=false, forbids shell execution, validates declared slice and nonempty contract/validator hashes; prepare is gated by strict Skill input receipt and records binding/context hashes; TDD transitions enforce RED failure with tests/docs-only paths, GREEN success after RED within production paths, REFACTOR success after GREEN within declared write set; blocked diagnostics use RMAP rule IDs; lifecycle candidate is non-authoritative and requires red/green/refactor order; resume rejects stale identities and failed/stale/superseded runs; protocol stage binding requires exactly one matching context/attempt, STAGE-{RED|GREEN|REFACTOR} IDs, matching plan/slice/run/attempt, empty authorizes; persistence validates bundle schema, artifact keys/bytes, path containment, no reparse points, immutable conflicts, complete ordered artifacts, and preserves listed observations; execute rejects existing run directories, requires bundle/store together, persists recovery-state with hashes and no authorization.
